scripts.imgs:full:
bash -lc 'mkdir -p images/webp; for SRC in $(find images -type f \
 -iregex '.*\.(jpg|jpeg|png)'); do REL=${SRC#images/}; DIR=$(dirname "$REL"); \
 mkdir -p "images/webp/$DIR"; npx @squoosh/cli --webp auto --resize "{\"width\":1600}" --output-dir "images/webp/$DIR" "$SRC"; done'
scripts.imgs:thumbs:
bash -lc 'mkdir -p images/thumbs; for SRC in $(find images -type f \
 -iregex '.*\.(jpg|jpeg|png)'); do REL=${SRC#images/}; DIR=$(dirname "$REL"); \
 mkdir -p "images/thumbs/$DIR"; npx @squoosh/cli --webp auto --resize "{\"width\":900}" --output-dir "images/thumbs/$DIR" "$SRC"; done'
scripts.build:js: npx esbuild script.js --minify --outfile=script.min.js && cp script.min.js script.js
scripts.build:css: npx esbuild styles.css --minify --outfile=styles.min.css && cp styles.min.css styles.css
scripts.build: npm run imgs:full && npm run imgs:thumbs && npm run build:js && npm run build:css
